# Dependency scopes of the published Android POMs, as generated by
# com.vanniktech.maven.publish from each module's build.gradle.kts.
#
#   compile -> declared api(...)         -> on consumers' compile classpath
#   runtime -> declared implementation(...) -> NOT on consumers' compile classpath
#
# A dependency whose types appear in a module's public signatures MUST be compile.
# Regenerate after an intentional change with:
#
#   node scripts/verify-android-api-dependencies.mjs --update
#
# See scripts/verify-android-api-dependencies.mjs for why this exists rather than
# a full ABI dump, and https://github.com/independo-gmbh/inderun/issues/189.

inderun-contracts compile org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib
inderun-core compile androidx.annotation:annotation
inderun-core compile app.independo.inderun:inderun-contracts
inderun-core compile org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib
inderun-core compile org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-coroutines-core
inderun-core runtime androidx.core:core-ktx
inderun-kotlin compile app.independo.inderun:inderun-contracts
inderun-kotlin compile app.independo.inderun:inderun-core
inderun-kotlin compile org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib
inderun-kotlin runtime app.independo.inderun:inderun-mlkit-providers
inderun-kotlin runtime org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-coroutines-core
inderun-mlkit-providers compile app.independo.inderun:inderun-contracts
inderun-mlkit-providers compile app.independo.inderun:inderun-core
inderun-mlkit-providers compile org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib
inderun-mlkit-providers compile org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-coroutines-core
inderun-mlkit-providers runtime com.google.mlkit:genai-prompt
inderun-onnx-providers compile app.independo.inderun:inderun-contracts
inderun-onnx-providers compile app.independo.inderun:inderun-core
inderun-onnx-providers compile org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib
inderun-onnx-providers runtime ai.djl.android:tokenizer-native

inderun-onnx-providers runtime org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-coroutines-core
inderun-onnx-providers runtime org.json:json
